title: Docker Logging with Fluentd — Companion Files
title_es: Logging en Docker con Fluentd — Archivos complementarios
description: Runnable Fluentd setup: forward-input config with parser filters and @type copy fan-out to Elasticsearch and stdout, a tail-based sidecar config, an S3 output variant, a full Docker Compose stack (Fluentd + ES + Kibana + demo app), structured-JSON demo apps in Node and Python, and an end-to-end verification script.
description_es: Setup ejecutable de Fluentd: config con input forward, filtros parser y fan-out con @type copy a Elasticsearch y stdout, config sidecar con tail, variante de output a S3, stack completo de Docker Compose (Fluentd + ES + Kibana + app demo), apps demo con JSON estructurado en Node y Python, y un script de verificación de punta a punta.
